statusLine.command: input=$(cat); dir=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir // .cwd'); model=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); short=${dir/#$HOME/\~}; git_info=''; if branch=$(git -C "$dir" symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null); then dirty=''; git -C "$dir" diff --quiet --ignore-submodules HEAD 2>/dev/null && git diff --cached --quiet 2>/dev/null || dirty='*'; ab=''; counts=$(git -C "$dir" rev-list --left-right --count @{upstream}...HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$counts" ]; then behind=$(printf '%s' "$counts" | cut -f1); ahead=$(printf '%s' "$counts" | cut -f2); [ "$behind" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null && ab="${ab}⇣"; [ "$ahead" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null && ab="${ab}⇡"; fi; git_info=$(printf ' \033[90m %s%s \033[36m%s\033[0m' "$branch" "$dirty" "$ab"); fi; printf '\033[34m%s\033[0m%s \033[35m%s\033[0m' "$short" "$git_info" "$model"
